defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20.

plugin.title: Shopware plugin fundamentals
plugin.description: Shopware plugin fundamentals: base class, lifecycle, plugin configuration, extension points, feature flags. Use when creating or configuring a Shopware plugin.
plugin.intro: Where a plugin hooks into the platform, and which lifecycle method runs when.

services.title: Shopware services and events
services.description: Shopware services: dependency injection, service decoration, service tags, event subscribers, the event catalogue, CLI commands. Use when registering a Shopware service, subscriber or console command.
services.intro: Extend by event subscriber first, decorator second — the platform's own guidance and the reason the event catalogue exists.

platform.title: Shopware platform services
platform.description: Shopware platform services: system config, config reference, logging, filesystem, rate limiter, number ranges. Use when the request names Shopware system config or logging.
platform.intro: Infrastructure a plugin consumes rather than extends.
